added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

0.reason: duplicated prototype exterior helper; the production fixed-point solve keeps one owner in nova/ and these scripts are not imported by product code

1.reason: prototype receipts verified from fresh H200 runs; a re-running regression test belongs to the production solve that replaces these scripts

findings.text: follow-on: CachedExterior duplicates the same capability in scripts/prototypes/fused_convergence/measure.py:75, and the surrounding wall and executable-size helpers are copied too, leaving two prototype owners to maintain.

follow-on: the added assertions only reject missing receipt rows and panels; the size, wall and convergence checks live in a run-directory verify.py that reads stored JSON, so a future code regression has no checked-in test that reruns the measurement and turns red.

item_verdicts.diff: eight commits from b5d3f094ebf408de23bad6c5422f8cf1e40ff30c to 49f7b4071a5c7eff70980d9795ebcc5887843332 add the runtime-argument prototype, receipt composer, renderer, four SVGs and two HTML records; measure.py:624-797 implements the vmapped JVP, LU and two-correction programs.
item_verdicts.done_when: prompt.txt:89-98 and the plan followup require H200 size, compile, wall, convergence, factor-build and two-state measures; verify.log and runtime-limited-retry.json record the limited checks, while docs/research/batched-factor-size.html:90-96 explicitly leaves diverted convergence unqualified.
item_verdicts.goal: prompt.txt:30 asks for sub-50 MB factor and chord programs without losing batched throughput or convergence; docs/research/batched-factor-size.html:75-89 records 1.349 and 1.359 MB at width 128, 0.279 ms per state and 128/128 limited convergence.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md:5-20 names eight commits, nine changed paths and the H200 receipts, but baseline_suite and after_suite are empty, so no comparable suite failure delta is recorded.
item_verdicts.write_paths: prompt.txt:68-72 grants the batched_factor prototype, one research page, its figures and its evidence fragment; every path in the eight-commit base-to-head diff lies within those grants.

justifications.durability: measure.py:135,154,168,300 asserts backend and setup validity and report.py:100-101 asserts receipt completeness; each can fail on invalid setup or missing rows, but none fails if the sub-50 MB or 1e-12 behavior regresses, and verify.py is an uncommitted check of stored receipts.
justifications.evidence: verify.log records a passed receipt check and fresh closure and perturbed-factor refusals, and runtime-limited-retry.json contains the measured 1.359 MB, 32.96 s, 0.279 ms per state and 128/128 values generated by measure.py:769-813.
justifications.fit: measure.py:3-35 follows the prototype's binary64 and runtime-operand idiom and introduces no forbidden symbol, although measure.py:33 imports an analytic fixture from a test module.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/research/batched-factor-size.html:75-96 establishes the limited size and batched wall targets while disclosing that diverted terminal residuals are NaN and outside this size measurement.
justifications.reuse: measure.py:38-121 copies wall, executable-size and cached-exterior capabilities already owned by scripts/prototypes/fused_convergence/measure.py:57-90, while its measured runtime-argument factor path is new.
justifications.scope_discipline: the nine base-to-head changed paths all fall under the four grants in prompt.txt:68-72, with no production module changed.
